best_hook.why: Cold nobleman on the cathedral steps: 'She won't be seeing anything for long.' - a death threat dropped casually

best_cliffhanger.why: Conspirator smiles down on the wedding: 'And its witch will be dead.' - execution sealed, exits covered, nothing resolved

must_promos.why: Wedding guests gloat about Juliana's death, the groom frets, the schemer confirms every entrance is covered and ends on 'its witch will be dead' - villains at peak confidence

standalone_risk: Neither Juliana nor the hero appears; a stranger hears side characters gloat about an unseen woman and a 'witch' with no idea who she is or who might stop them
notes: Transitional wedding-arrival episode; the doors opening is only the bride, so it cannot be used as a hero-arrival tease honestly.
